notes.title: 1.2 Build is Now Live
notes.content:
The following fixes have been made:
1. Fixed wall appearing in Survival Mode that blocks the view of map.
2. Smoothed turning of Shadow Demons when they turn to face the player.

notes.title: Game Launching Error
notes.content:
It has been brought to our attention that the "missing executable" error is occurring for those who have the game installed after updating. We had to upload the 1.1 update in a different way from before which changed the file path from the old version. The best solution we have, unfortunately, would be the following:
1. Uninstall the game.
2. In your file browser, Go (Installed drive, IE C:)...SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\The Masters Survival. You should also be able to get there by right clicking on the game in your Steam Library>Properties>Local Files>Click on the "Browse..." button to be taken directly to the game folder.
3. Delete the entire The Masters Survival folder.
4. Reinstall the game.

Luckily, your save data is stored separately in your user's Appdata folder in your C: drive, so no need to worry about losing your progress. 

We apologize for the inconvenience :(

notes.title: Game Launch Fix
notes.content: Both the Demo and Full versions of the game has been corrected and should be launching without error. We apologize for The inconvenience.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
The following updates have been made:
- Hit detection from all attacks to enemies has been rebuilt and improved.
- Hit detection from Final Boss's special attack improved.
- Hit animation from Shadow Demons and Final Boss now working.
- Water Blasts attacks now only damage enemies it overlaps.
- Fixed button placement in UI menus.
- Fixed issue with unlockable character in Survival Mode where Shadow Demons are constantly spawning.

notes.title: Attending Phoenix Fan Fusion
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Announcing on here on Steam that we will be at the Phoenix Fan Fusion, Located in Phoenix, Arizona for anyone to come meet us! The event takes place between May 27th-May 29th, 2022.

We will be selling the physical published books (The Masters: RE: The New Cast and The Masters: RE: Revolver) that are associated with The Masters: Survival, along with prints for the game's poster, other prints, and stickers. And yes, we will be signing them.

The Masters: Survival is currently on sale as part of the "Going Rogue" event happening now.

Hope to see everyone there!
